reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the mechanism of force-constant disorder from studies on FeCoCrMnNi (P9, P12, P42, P43) with the experimental observation of comparable lattice/electronic contributions in concentrated alloys (P19) and applies this combined insight to predict a specific quantitative reduction (20-30%) in lattice thermal conductivity for HfNbTaTiZr, a refractory BCC alloy not studied for this mechanism in the provided passages. It proposes a new multi-scale model to test this, going beyond the individual findings.
copied_elements: force-constant fluctuations as dominant phonon scattering source (P9, P12, P42, P43)
lattice and electronic contributions comparable at low temperatures (P19)
separation of lattice and electronic conductivity via Wiedemann-Franz law (P11)
importance of low oxygen content for single-phase HfNbTaTiZr (P24)
